audits.cleanReason: Swept all short narration fragments (script-listed, roughly 150 sentences of 4 words or fewer) for A1/A2 verdict tags. Swept 'which' tails, 'the kind of'/'something about'/'every' generalizers, prepositional-front sentences for A8, and paragraph and scene endings for B1-B4. Every candidate either passes the 'could she mutter it' test as Jaina's free indirect idiom ('Wrong, then.' 'Herself, obviously.' 'Well. Here was where it ended up.' 'which was low of her') or is concrete perception or operational inference: 'Mother Haw, of course.', 'as they did it in every village in Lordaeron' driving the oven-deadline decision, and 'Every apprentice in Dalaran knew that much.' as training fact. The A8 candidates ('Under the sweetness something thin and sharp...', 'Somewhere in the rounds the smell came in...', 'And a sound... somebody prising a lid off a box') each delay the source because Jaina cannot yet name it, which is the keep condition. The one B1-flavoured close at L735 is killed under F7 in the gpt-5 guide and is not re-killed here. Details are in the scratchpad.

Checked stand-in nouns chapter-wide: shape, pressure, truth, work, answer and cost have no abstract stand-in uses. The 'something' cluster (15 hits, including tool vague_pointers L490, L681, L783) is POV-limited unknowns, not prestige abstraction. Jaina cannot hear Sylvanas through the glass (a plan mandate for B6), cannot see inside her own torn palm, and mistakes the foam for flour. In every case the line either names the sign it has (hens, tearing low in the palm, white then bubbling) or admits the gap honestly. The tactical and inferential lines all cash out on the page: 'One part to keep. One part to wait.' is anchored by 'through a baker's oven and into a man's milk, and sat down in him and waited'; 'She had Windrunner down as maps' expands at once into ground, ambush angles, ears and the map read backward; 'He was alive, and frightened, and the hole under the floor and the open sack and the jar...' names the objects. Dialogue: 'You don't know what you're keeping them from' is kept as a recited catechism whose emptiness the next paragraph exposes, and the plan forbids naming the cult here. 'There's something else in it too' is kept as deliberate withholding after the lane lesson about saying 'necromantic' in front of the street. 'or something else' at L486 is kept because B7 owns the 'on purpose' reveal. No P5 note-speak was found.

Six translation setups were audited as exchanges. (1) 'How much?' -> 'Small. Half a fist. A fist. Everywhere.' is a four-step scale Tobin writes on the slate at once. (2) Jaina's held-back small-words version 'It's the bread. Stop them eating the bread.' names a usable target. (3) 'Captain... Your baker lights his oven before dawn?' -> 'Then you have until cockcrow.' gives a visible threshold, matching the calibration KEEP. (4) 'Tell me what to shut' -> 'The granary. The bakehouse. Tonight, now... nobody carries a sack out of either' gives named targets plus a timing trigger. (5) Brask's 'That's the big granaries. Down the grain road, south and west, past the ford. Three days, with a cart.' gives route, direction and distance. (6) 'made herself say plainly what the wards did' -> 'They held the door, so that nothing more could come in and nothing that was in could get any further. What was in was in, and the body would do the rest or it wouldn't.' cashes the metaphor out in the same sentence.
